sheets.name: run_1
sheets.action: running (her move loop): a quick run, the Chakram carried in her near hand, the LEGS SWAPPING every half cycle, the body bobbing with each stride, the far arm swinging as the pale figure's
sheets.weapons: THE CHAKRAM goes where the pale figure has it, frame by frame (image 3 shows it in colour): normally upright in her NEAR hand (image left) by her hip; raised over her head, swung forward or caught in a hand when the pale figure does it; and NOT DRAWN AT ALL when the pale figure's hands are empty (it is flying - an effect). Only ONE Chakram, never two. Her FAR hand (image right) keeps its brown glove.
sheets.legs: Frame 1: PASSING: both feet together under her hips, one planted, the other just lifting off. Frame 2: STRIDE: the front foot planted ahead (right), the back leg bent behind her, its foot lifting off the ground. The two legs TAKE TURNS: in frames 1-4 the NEAR leg (the lighter one) is the one that ends in front, in frames 5-8 the FAR leg (the darker one). Follow the pale figure's LEGS exactly - frames 1 and 5 have both feet under her; never both legs stretched apart in every frame.
